mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.1%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over 3 months signals monetary tightening that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 3-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand that drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 5%), tight labor market conditions fuel inflationary pressures that prompt Federal Reserve rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE is below 5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth is positive, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 over 3 months signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 90 in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high GDP growth regime (annualized GDPC1 growth above 3%), strong economic expansion supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high GDP growth regime (GDPC1 growth > 3% annualized)
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 growth is above 3% annualized, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5%) indicates a monetary policy response to economic weakness, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE is above 5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
